goal: Build a free, student-friendly AI career assistant (web-only) that tailors resumes to job descriptions, scans JDs for keywords, provides an interview coach, and tracks job applications.
non_goals: No third-party UI kits beyond shadcn/ui
Do not invent features, files, or endpoints not listed

tech_stack.frontend: Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
tech_stack.backend: Next.js API routes (server actions), Zod validation

rules: Extract only from JD text; no imaginary skills
Limit default assistant answers to <=120 words
Use Supabase server client with RLS
Only operate on rows where user_id = auth.uid()

widgets: Quick actions (Tailor, Scan, Coach, Add Application)

components: Prompt presets (Behavioral, Frontend, Backend, System Design)

acceptance_tests: Auth: unauthenticated users are redirected from /dashboard to /login
Tailor: returns 3-6 bullets and a summary; none contain tools not in resume/JD
Scan: returns arrays with at least 10 JD keywords for typical SWE JD
Coach: responses under 120 words unless user asks for more
Tracker: CRUD works and RLS prevents cross-user access
security_privacy: Do not log PII or raw resumes in console
Store AI prompts and messages under user_id in messages table
RLS must be enabled and enforced
instructions_for_ai: Follow the provided file paths; do not rename or invent directories
If a dependency or API is ambiguous, stop and output a clarification request
Keep UI minimal, student-friendly, and clean (Tailwind + shadcn)
